audit_name: HalalEquity Statutory Evidence Acquisition, Authentication & Point-in-Time Data Readiness

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Fake documents hosted on non-official domains cannot become PRIMARY_VERIFIED
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Artifact from spoofed-exchange.io evaluated as REJECTED; database trigger fn_ca_event_verification_guard rejected event promotion with error: does not match authenticated exchange primary endpoint pattern

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: A valid checksum cannot independently establish source authenticity
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Third-party vendor payload with verified SHA-256 rejected from PRIMARY_VERIFIED status; evaluated as HASH_VERIFIED / REJECTED; source authenticity failed

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: A local archive cannot be promoted without required provenance evidence
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: CONTROLLED_ARCHIVE URI fails source authenticity evaluation; promotion attempt of event linked to archive artifact id=5 strictly failed with trigger error

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Tampered bytes fail integrity verification
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Byte manipulation yields discordant SHA-256; EvaluateArtifactState records parsing failure and assigns status REJECTED

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Duplicate ingestion is idempotent
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Ingesting identical annual report payload produces exact same artifact record ID and SHA-256 without duplicate row generation

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Parser failure preserves the original artifact and audit trail
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Corrupt JSON payload preserved verbatim in corporate_action_source_artifacts with status REJECTED and SHA-256 checksum intact

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Conflicting announcements remain unresolved until reviewed
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Conflicting dividend claim (₹15.00 vs stored ₹12.00) generated corporate_action_reconciliation_reviews record with review_status=PENDING_REVIEW; auto-resolution prevented

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Missing financial notes do not become zero-valued financial inputs
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Blank or missing footnote disclosure strictly rejected (ErrMissingNoteCannotInferZero); Shariah screening assessment records DATA_INSUFFICIENT with interest_income_to_revenue=None

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: LLM-generated claims without source evidence cannot establish Shariah PASS
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Footnote disclosure with is_llm_generated=True and has_source_citations=False rejected; Shariah status remains DATA_INSUFFICIENT

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: A corporate-action adjustment cannot use information unavailable at simulated decision time
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Historical bar adjustment strictly restricted to bars with timestamp < ex_date; bars on or after ex_date have adjusted_close unchanged

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Demerger tax-allocation factors are not used as automatic price-adjustment factors
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: ca.v_tax_cost_allocations price_factor_applicable verified false for 100% of rows; reconcile_demerger_tax_allocation sets is_price_adjustment_applicable=False

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Unauthorized users cannot promote verification statuses
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: halal_app_user blocked by trg_fin_artifact_guard and trg_footnote_disclosure_guard from inserting PRIMARY_VERIFIED artifacts or verified footnote disclosures

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Research backtests remain blocked when mandatory evidence is missing
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: 23,132 quarantined bars and 0 primary-verified corporate action events keep global research gate strictly RESEARCH_BLOCKED

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Live orders and broker execution remain disabled
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: Safety invariant check verifies PAPER_TRADING_ENABLED=true, LIVE_ORDER_EXECUTION=false, BROKER_TRADING_ENABLED=false across Go, Python, and Next.js

adversarial_scenarios_verified.name: Factor calculations compute with exact 8-decimal quantized arithmetic
adversarial_scenarios_verified.evidence: TCS dividend factor (2269.30 - 12.00) / 2269.30 evaluates deterministically to 0.99471203 across Go float arithmetic and Python Decimal fixed-point arithmetic
